item.title: Jack Johnson Announces AU/NZ Dates With Ben Harper and John Butler
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update. We've got some exciting news for fans in Australia and New Zealand. Jack Johnson has just announced a six-date tour, kicking off in November, and he's bringing some special guests along for the ride."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Johnson will be joined by Ben Harper and John Butler, who will both perform solo and acoustic sets. The tour, called the SURFILMUSIC 2026 Australia & New Zealand Tour, will hit cities like Brisbane, Perth, Sydney, and Melbourne, before wrapping up in North Canterbury, New Zealand on November 22nd."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This tour marks Johnson's first return to Australia and New Zealand since 2022, and it's all part of the celebration of his new documentary soundtrack, which drops on May 15th. The documentary itself premiered at SXSW in March and explores Johnson's journey from surfer to filmmaker to musician."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Fans can expect to hear some of Johnson's classic hits, like 'Better Together' and 'Sitting, Waiting, Wishing', as well as some new material from the soundtrack. And with the addition of Harper and Butler, this is definitely a tour you won't want to miss. Tickets go on sale on May 12th, so mark your calendars."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for this week. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one."
